name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II (Plutonium Mod)

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode. Configure the relevant config file accordingly - 'Plutonium/storage/t6/dedicated.cfg' for Multiplayer, 'Plutonium/storage/t6/dedicated_zm.cfg' for Zombies

configurationFields.label: Server Key
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server key](https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys) required to run the server. This also sets the server name. A Plutonium account must be at least one week old to create a key, and game ownership must be [verified](https://forum.plutonium.pw/topic/32250/an-update-on-game-ownership-verification)

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Map Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to enable map rotation (the Map Rotation List must then also be set) or to load a specific initial map (the Initial Game Type and Initial Map must then also be set)

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Configure the map rotation in 'dedicated.cfg' or 'dedicated_zm.cfg' (as applicable)

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type to start the server with. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured. Settings for each game type can be set in 'dedicated.cfg' or 'dedicated_zm.cfg' (as applicable)

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. See 'dedicated.cfg' or 'dedicated_zm.cfg' (as applicable) for map names. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured

configurationFields.label: Load Mod
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod to load when starting the server, based on the path to the mod in the 'Plutonium/storage/t6' directory

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time. Maximum 18 for Multiplayer, 8 for Zombies (4 recommended)

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the base URL for [fast download](https://plutonium.pw/docs/server/t6/fastdl/) of mods

configurationFields.label: RCON Rate Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the RCON rate limit (per IP). Localhost RCON commands are not rate limited

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Server Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice quality level

configurationFields.label: Allow Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: If set, Aim Assist will be allowed on gamepads

configurationFields.label: Enable Demo Recording
configurationFields.description: If set, matches will be recorded as demo files

configurationFields.label: Server Say Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name that server-side 'say' commands show up as

configurationFields.label: Replace Bots
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will try to kick a bot when a player joins a full game

configurationFields.label: Player Collision Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets who players collide with

configurationFields.label: Player Ejection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets from whom players are ejected

configurationFields.label: Enable Team To Affect Bullet Penetration
configurationFields.description: If enabled, team members will affect bullet penetration

configurationFields.label: Fix Bullet Damage Duplication
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the issue where players that are clipped inside each other receive duplicate bullet damage will be fixed

configurationFields.label: Allow Rocket Jumps
configurationFields.description: If enabled, rocket jumps will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Show Perks on Spawn (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, currently equipped perks will be displayed on the HUD when spawning

configurationFields.label: Delete Explosives On Spawn (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, thrown lethal explosives will be removed when killed

configurationFields.label: Disable Custom Classes (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, custom classes will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Rank (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Every player with a level above the set value will be blocked

configurationFields.label: Minimum Prestige (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Every player with a prestige below the set value will be blocked

configurationFields.label: Custom Team Names (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: Sets custom team names on the scoreboard

configurationFields.label: Allow Depth Of Field (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If disabled, clients will not be allowed to have Depth of Field, in order to prevent glitches and gain performance

configurationFields.label: DSR-50 Patches (Multiplayer)
configurationFields.description: If set, DSR-50 patches will be applied on the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Starting Players (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum players needed to start the game. Do NOT set this higher than the Player Limit!

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level for Zombies mode. If set to Easy, it must be manually set on the client as well

configurationFields.label: Fix Unkillable Zombies Bug (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, fixes the unkillable zombies in traps bug

configurationFields.label: Enable Starting Round (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the starting round. Works on all maps

configurationFields.label: Remove Magic (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If enabled, all supernatural assistance will be removed. Only Survival and Grief gametypes have this option!

configurationFields.label: Headshots Only (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only headshots will be allowed. Only Survival and Grief have this option!

configurationFields.label: Allow Hellhounds (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If enabled, Hellhounds will be allowed. Only Survival has this option!

configurationFields.label: Allow Cleansed Loadout (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be allowed to choose their Loadout. Only Turned has this option!

configurationFields.label: Team Count (Zombies)
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of teams. Set to 2 by default when loading Grief

deploymentSteps.name: Disable Prefix Sound
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && wget -q -N https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x winetricks; export WINEPREFIX=\"{SERVER_DIR}/.wine\"; export WINEARCH=win32; ./winetricks sound=disabled > winescript_log.txt 2>&1"

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
